payload.entry: Record parse contract for the next phase: claimed items expose additive top-level/per-item `record` metadata; `type` is the configured ID and `path` is vault-relative. A single typed source uses `range`; repeated values use `range: null` plus individual `value_ranges[]`, keeping intervening note spans separate. Missing titles retain the schema and need `record_title`; missing required values need `record_value`. Configured record targets append after note routes, while task-only scans filter them out.

Implemented record planner-backed capture-parse metadata and diagnostics, record-folder discovery/completion, and task-only scanner exclusions. Verified 156 record-filtered Rust tests passed (1 ignored), cargo check, cargo fmt --check, docs-gen, full docs-check, git diff --check, and no outstanding epic symbols.

payload.entry: JSON/contract for bob-cli-ir.5.1.4 and bob-cli-ir.11: capture success adds top-level note_files (skip_serializing_if empty) with path, action="create", record_type, properties[{key,label,value,display,source}], body, markdown. Item record_note is serde skip and collected into note_files. value/display are Option<String> (display copied into value so CaptureResult stays Eq; choice displays use labels like "Liked"). source is "typed"|"default". Dry-run and commit share exact markdown bytes. Incomplete records exit 2 with extra.draft (ready-to-copy, title @dir/ or @dir/^stem, typed fields, omitted required as key:: … plus choice/date hints), extra.missing, extra.invalid[{field,code,message}]. Collisions use code record_exists and copy "record already exists: {path} (open it; adding to it with `@{dir}/{stem}` comes later)". schema_version stays 1; GRAMMAR_REVISION stays 20. No new capture subcommand or public flag. Planner: capture/record_note.rs stages via CaptureBatchPlanner with target_existed false; reserved_paths from planner.staged_snapshot() (records, projects, templates). Missing parent dirs created only at commit (ensure_new_file_parents) and rolled back when empty; PLANT_BEFORE_INSTALL race keeps foreign bytes. Human dry-run: "{prefix} would create  {ordinal}{emoji}new {kind}  {target}"; then exact markdown. Success: "{prefix} {emoji}new {kind}  {ordinal}{target}" plus field displays and "{n} note(s)". Record items skip Gmail rewrite, task-block, freshness, ledger, relations.
